names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 28 aprilie, «Sfinții Mucenici Maxim, Cvintilian și Dadas din Ozovia».
The same man, spelled so in the closing sentence of the life doxologia.ro prints for the three: «Sfinţii Mucenici Maxim, Dada şi Cvintilian».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Απριλίου, «Άγιοι Κυντιλλιανός, Μάξιμος και Δάδας», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 28. април ст. ст., „Св. муч. Максим, Дада и Квинтилијан.“ Св. муч. stands over all three names and муч. is the `martyr` this folder already carries; the heading gives no epithet and no village. The form is Дада, as the folder's Romanian forms are Dadas and Dada both. One other folder already holds the same bare form; the fold was measured and the row is in the batch's commit message.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 28 aprilie — «Sfinții Mucenici Maxim, Cvintilian și Dadas din Ozovia»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Κυντιλλιανός, Μάξιμος και Δάδας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives the three no years: it sets them only in the reigns of «Μαξιμιανού (285 - 305 μ.Χ.) και Διοκλητιανού (284 - 305 μ.Χ.)» and under «τῶν ὑπάτων Γαβιβίου και Ταρκυΐνου», so no `dates` were taken. **The Greek keeps the three a fortnight before the Romanian**, which prints them on 28 aprilie; both pages are the same company — the three readers of the Church from Ozovia, beheaded together — and the Greek adds their office, the consuls' names, and the resting place of the relics at Constantinople, in the church of the Most Holy Mother of God «ἐν τοὶς Βιγλεντίου», where their synaxis was kept. The page prints no hymn. The corpus's other Dadas, the companion of Gobdelaas with a Greek row on 29 Σεπτεμβρίου, is another man; nothing on this page joins them.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 11.05.2026 (28. април ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Максим, Дада и Квинтилијан.“

attestations.note: The second name of an enumerated heading of three. Three short sentences: Diocletian's time, the voivode Tarquinius as judge, prison and torments, and beheading with the sword. **This book keeps the three on 28 April with the Romanian calendar and against the Greek 13 April**, and **„у време Диоклецијана“ is a reign with no printed bounds** and was not turned into a date, so this folder stays undated. The form folds with `dadas-companion-of-gobdelaas`'s, predicted before drafting and measured after; the row is in the batch's commit message. The Prologue prints no hymn.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfinților Mucenici Maxim, Cvintilian și Dadas din Ozovia», Glasul 4

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their striving won from Thee, our God, the crowns of incorruption; for having Thy strength, they overthrew their tormentors and shattered the feeble daring of the demons. By their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.
